last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription constipation and digestive-health topics. The main query set returned 162 unique PubMed PMIDs, 162 fetched article records, and 159 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 21320737, 41288808, 29760761, 39356506, 32969946, 20433751, 22225544, 41383802, 37905980, 35554601, 30843436, 37684725, 32891277, 34074830, 36537785, and 34319275. Fifteen retained references were new to the database; PMID 32969946 was already linked to the magnesium constipation entry. Thirteen new entries across thirteen qualified topics retain numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects. Psyllium, kiwifruit, magnesium, yogurt, inulin, and peppermint oil topics were linked to existing entries, with new supporting references attached to psyllium, kiwifruit, and peppermint oil. Chia seed, kefir, resistant starch, partially hydrolyzed guar gum, acacia fiber, oat bran, wheat bran, aloe vera, ginger, yoga, and toilet training topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
